name: ExposureItems
description: The documents that make up the obligo
technicalDescription: Mirror, read-only (exposure_items). The breakdown behind CustomerExposure.obligoTotal as Priority gives it: open invoices, delivery notes not yet invoiced, cheques received and not yet deposited, open orders. One row per document. Shown grouped by itemType on the customer card tab; undeposited cheques are also shown apart as expected to drop on deposit.

columns.name: reference
columns.description: Document number (invoice, delivery note, cheque or order number)

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Amount ILS counted in the obligo

columns.name: source
columns.description: Data source: priority-api, icic (CreditCovers only) or test-fixture (marked test data, removed by DeleteTestFixtures). Writers must set it

columns.name: syncedAt
columns.description: When this row was last synced
